versions.changelog:
Initial release of the knownas skill.

- Gives your OpenClaw gateway a stable public name and HTTPS addresses via knownas.dev.
- Provides setup, repoint, status, remove, and channel management commands for knownas integration.
- Ensures proper identity creation, secure origin verification, and safe handling of API keys.
- Publishes only owner-chosen information in the public record.
- Supports automatic handling of route proof tokens and webhook/API endpoint updates after tunnel restarts.
